name: Heron Health
description: Patient Triage for low aquity Dermatology and other medical specialty care
content: Patients are using LLMs for medical triage on low aquity issues without professional oversight. Heron catches instances of medical triage, prepares a patient summary, and connects the user to local providers to give actual oversight. Key features: Management of health information related to dermatology, translation of queries to onboarding material for dermatology specialists, backend system automation for submitting patient inquiries into triage portal.
